focus: Section 3.2.1: scaled dot-product attention, Attention(Q,K,V) = softmax(QK^T / sqrt(d_k)) V, with small editable Q, K, V matrices. Show similarity scores, normalized attention weights, and the output. The learner edits values and switches scaling on/off. Guide them through equal scores and a dominant score. Each row of weights sums to one; the output equals the weighted sum of V rows. Do not train a Transformer.
audience: engineering undergraduate who knows matrix multiplication but not Transformers
